title: The AI bubble: are we headed for a crash?

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: The AI bubble is real — built on hype, not substance. Real innovation is slow, and most "AI" is just marketing. (3 sec)

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: You're wrong. AI is already embedded in critical systems — from healthcare to finance. It's not a bubble; it's a revolution. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: But most "AI" lacks real protocols. Without standardization, it's a fragmented, unsustainable mess. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Protocols evolve. Look at Kubernetes — once niche, now foundational. AI will follow the same path. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: This isn't a bubble — it's the future. (4 sec)
